text: {"lessons":["The account’s rise through Period 7 did not guarantee continued gains; I should not infer future returns from recent performance.","Selling Stock A after a large gain did not prevent later losses in the overall account, so I should assess the whole portfolio rather than anchor on one position’s gain.","As an infrequent trader who feels losses keenly, I should avoid reactive changes after declines and make deliberate decisions consistent with my portfolio goals."]}
